razao: Pipesworld-Strips features complex interactions where items follow each other in pipes, challenging pure delete-relaxation heuristics. A portfolio combining novelty-based search (which handles structural complexity well) with landmark and causal-graph heuristics over finite-domain representations is highly effective for maximizing coverage on this domain.
